categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Hongchang Electric Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of fluid electromagnetic valves, sensors, and other electrical appliance components. Its main products include fluid electromagnetic valves, modular components, water level sensors, and automotive electronic water pumps. The company serves both the home appliance sector and the automotive parts sector, with a focus on washing machines, smart toilets, dishwashers, water purifiers, and automotive interior parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced magnetic sensing and fluid control technologies, holding 207 patents including 19 invention patents. It emphasizes modular component design integrating electromagnetic valves with other waterway parts to improve production efficiency and product adaptability. The production process is order-driven with strict quality control adhering to ISO9001 and other certifications, and includes in-house R&D combined with cooperative development with universities. The company also develops intelligent and energy-efficient products such as electronic water pumps and automatic dosing modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international home appliance manufacturers including Haier, Midea, Hisense, Panasonic, Siemens, TCL, and automotive companies like Leapmotor and Geely. The company’s products are critical components in washing machines, smart toilets, dishwashers, water purifiers, and automotive interiors. The markets served are primarily the home appliance and automotive industries, with growing focus on smart and high-end appliance segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Zhejiang Province and subsidiaries in other regions including Jiangsu and Anhui. It also actively expands overseas markets, supplying European customers such as Siemens and developing markets in Vietnam, India, and Russia through domestic appliance exporters’ overseas factories. Domestic sales account for over 90% of revenue, with international sales growing steadily.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Hongchang Electric Technology operates primarily as a midstream supplier in the home appliance and automotive supply chains, manufacturing specialized components like electromagnetic valves and modular assemblies that are integrated into finished appliances and vehicles by downstream OEMs. It functions as a Tier 1 or Tier 2 supplier, providing critical parts directly to major appliance and automotive manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on continuous innovation in fluid electromagnetic valve technology and modular component integration to enhance product functionality and production efficiency. It invests heavily in R&D, expanding into smart appliance components such as electronic water pumps and automatic dosing systems. The company also aims to grow its automotive parts business and equipment automation sector, while strengthening overseas market penetration and deepening cooperation with key customers on technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of home appliance components and automotive parts under long-term contracts with major customers. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with sales recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns income from government subsidies and financial asset investments, but product sales constitute the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic washing machine valve market with approximately 65% market share. It competes with both domestic and foreign suppliers, especially in high-end product segments traditionally dominated by foreign firms. Its strong R&D capabilities, quality control, and long-term customer relationships provide competitive advantages. The industry is characterized by high concentration among downstream appliance manufacturers, influencing supplier dynamics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, a 16% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 52.5 million, reflecting a decline due to increased costs and investments. The company has steadily grown its revenue base, expanded its product lines, and increased R&D spending to about 4.3% of revenue. It maintains a solid asset base exceeding RMB 2 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and new product development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Hongchang Electric Technology emphasizes high-quality, innovative electromagnetic valve and modular component solutions tailored to customer needs, enhancing appliance performance and production efficiency. Its strong patent portfolio, industry-standard leadership, and ability to provide integrated modular assemblies differentiate it from competitors. The company’s focus on smart, energy-efficient products and close collaboration with leading appliance manufacturers underpin its value proposition of delivering reliable, advanced components that support customers’ product upgrades and market competitiveness.
